messages.subject: How to receive downlaod url link in shiny and javascript
parts:
How one can get a download url in javascript for downloading the plot.
I am using javascript and shiny R with a download link shown in javascript.
Whenever a link is clicked the client send a  request with data to server and generate a pdf of the plot and wants to get a link of that pdf in return.
I am not able to receive the url for that pdf. Though downloadHandler generates a link and shown with shiny output 'downloaButton', but I am not using  'downloaButton'
but generating  link dynamically whenever is needed.
